dish_name: Lok lak
dish_name_kh: ឡុកឡាក់
recipe_title: Lok lak (ឡុកឡាក់)
description: Stir-fried marinated beef cubes on fresh salad, with a lime and Kampot pepper dip.
ingredients: ["400 g beef sirloin or tenderloin, cut into 2 cm cubes", "2 tbsp oyster sauce", "1 tbsp soy sauce", "1 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tsp sugar", "1 tbsp tomato ketchup (optional, Phnom Penh style)", "4 cloves garlic, minced", "½ tsp ground black pepper", "1 tbsp vegetable oil", "1 small onion, cut into wedges", "Lettuce leaves, sliced tomato and cucumber, to serve", "2 eggs, fried (optional)", "Dip (tuk meric): juice of 2 limes, 1 tsp freshly ground Kampot pepper, ½ tsp salt", "Steamed jasmine rice, to serve"]
steps: ["Mix the beef with the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar, ketchup, half the garlic and the pepper. Marinate for at least 30 minutes.", "Make the dip: mix the lime juice, Kampot pepper and salt in small bowls.", "Arrange the lettuce, tomato and cucumber on the plates.", "Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and fry the rest of the garlic until fragrant.", "Add the beef in one layer and sear for 1–2 minutes without stirring, then stir-fry 2–3 minutes more until browned outside and still pink inside.", "Add the onion and toss for 1 minute.", "Spoon the beef over the salad, top with a fried egg and serve with rice and the lime-pepper dip."]

dish_name: Amok (fish amok)
dish_name_kh: អាម៉ុកត្រី
recipe_title: Amok trey, steamed fish amok (អាម៉ុកត្រី)
description: Fish steamed in a coconut and kroeung custard, traditionally in banana-leaf cups.
ingredients: ["Kroeung: 2 stalks lemongrass, thinly sliced, 3 cm galangal, sliced, 3 cm fresh turmeric (or 1 tsp ground), 4 kaffir lime leaves, stems removed, 4 cloves garlic, 3 shallots, 2 dried red chillies, soaked (optional)", "500 g white fish fillet (snakehead, catfish or tilapia), thinly sliced", "400 ml coconut milk (keep 4 tbsp of the thick cream for the top)", "1 egg", "1½ tbsp fish sauce", "1 tsp palm sugar", "1 tsp prahok or shrimp paste (optional)", "1 handful noni leaves (slek ngor) or spinach, shredded", "2 kaffir lime leaves, very thinly sliced, and 1 red chilli, sliced, to garnish", "Banana leaves to fold 4 cups (or 4 small bowls)"]
steps: ["Pound or blend the kroeung ingredients into a smooth paste.", "Mix the paste with the coconut milk, egg, fish sauce, palm sugar and prahok until smooth.", "Fold in the fish and let it stand for 10 minutes.", "Fold banana-leaf cups (or use bowls) and line them with the shredded leaves.", "Fill the cups with the fish mixture and steam over boiling water for 20–25 minutes, until set like a soft custard.", "Top each with a spoon of coconut cream, kaffir lime leaf and chilli, steam 1 more minute and serve with rice."]

dish_name: Khor (caramelised braised pork)
dish_name_kh: ខសាច់ជ្រូក
recipe_title: Khor sach chrouk, caramelised pork with eggs (ខសាច់ជ្រូក)
description: Pork belly and eggs slowly braised in palm-sugar caramel and fish sauce.
ingredients: ["600 g pork belly, cut into 3 cm pieces", "6 eggs, hard-boiled and peeled", "3 tbsp palm sugar", "3 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tbsp dark soy sauce", "1 tbsp light soy sauce", "5 cloves garlic, crushed", "2 star anise (optional)", "½ tsp ground black pepper", "750 ml water or coconut water", "Spring onion, to garnish", "Steamed rice and pickled vegetables (chruok), to serve"]
steps: ["Melt the palm sugar in a heavy pot over medium heat until it turns a deep amber caramel.", "Add the garlic, then the pork, and stir for about 5 minutes until the pork is coated and lightly browned.", "Add the fish sauce, both soy sauces, star anise and pepper, and stir for 1 minute.", "Pour in the water or coconut water, bring to a boil and skim off the foam.", "Cover and simmer gently for 60 minutes.", "Add the eggs and simmer uncovered for 20–30 minutes more, until the pork is tender and the sauce is dark and glossy.", "Taste and adjust with fish sauce or sugar. Garnish with spring onion and serve with rice and pickles."]

dish_name: Samlor korko
dish_name_kh: សម្លកកូរ
recipe_title: Samlor korko, stirred vegetable soup (សម្លកកូរ)
description: A thick country soup of green kroeung, prahok and toasted rice with many vegetables.
ingredients: ["Kroeung: 3 stalks lemongrass, 4 cm galangal, 2 cm turmeric, 4 kaffir lime leaves, 4 cloves garlic, 3 shallots", "300 g pork or catfish fillet, sliced", "2 tbsp prahok (fermented fish paste)", "3 tbsp toasted rice, ground", "1 small green papaya, peeled and cut into pieces", "200 g pumpkin, cubed", "4 Thai eggplants, quartered", "1 handful pea eggplants", "100 g long beans, cut into 4 cm pieces", "1 green banana, peeled and sliced (optional)", "1 bunch morning glory or moringa leaves", "1.5 litres water", "2 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tsp sugar", "1 tbsp vegetable oil"]
steps: ["Pound the kroeung into a paste. If you have no ready-made toasted rice, toast raw rice in a dry pan until golden and grind it.", "Heat the oil in a large pot and fry the kroeung and prahok for 2–3 minutes until fragrant.", "Add the pork or fish and stir until it changes colour.", "Add the water and bring to a boil. Add the papaya, pumpkin and banana and simmer for 15 minutes.", "Add the eggplants and long beans and simmer for 10 minutes.", "Stir in the ground toasted rice to thicken, and season with fish sauce and sugar.", "Add the leafy greens, cook for 2 minutes and serve hot with rice."]

dish_name: Num banh chok
dish_name_kh: នំបញ្ចុក
recipe_title: Num banh chok samlor Khmer, rice noodles with fish gravy (នំបញ្ចុកសម្លខ្មែរ)
description: Fresh rice noodles under a green-yellow fish and coconut gravy, with lots of raw vegetables.
ingredients: ["Kroeung: 4 stalks lemongrass, 5 cm galangal, 3 cm turmeric, 5 kaffir lime leaves, 6 cloves garlic, 4 shallots", "500 g fish (snakehead, mackerel or catfish)", "400 ml coconut milk", "1 tbsp prahok", "2 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tbsp palm sugar", "1 tsp salt", "1 litre water", "1 kg fresh rice noodles (num banh chok)", "To serve: bean sprouts, sliced cucumber, shredded banana blossom, long beans, water lily stems, Thai basil, mint, lime wedges, dried chilli"]
steps: ["Simmer the fish in the water with a pinch of salt for 15 minutes. Take it out and keep the broth.", "Remove the skin and bones and pound the fish flesh with the kroeung into a coarse paste.", "Bring the broth back to a simmer and stir in the fish paste, prahok and coconut milk.", "Season with fish sauce, palm sugar and salt and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring often, until slightly thick.", "Rinse the noodles in warm water and divide them among bowls.", "Top with the vegetables and herbs, ladle the hot gravy over and serve with lime and chilli."]

dish_name: Khmer curry (kari)
dish_name_kh: សម្លការីសាច់មាន់
recipe_title: Samlor kari sach moan, Khmer chicken curry (សម្លការីសាច់មាន់)
description: A mild red coconut curry with chicken and sweet potato, eaten with bread, rice or noodles.
ingredients: ["Kroeung: 4 stalks lemongrass, 4 cm galangal, 2 cm turmeric, 4 kaffir lime leaves, 5 cloves garlic, 4 shallots, 6 dried red chillies (soaked)", "1 kg chicken pieces on the bone", "800 ml coconut milk", "2 sweet potatoes, cubed", "3 potatoes, cubed (optional)", "1 onion, cut into wedges", "4 Thai eggplants or 1 long eggplant", "100 g long beans", "2 tbsp curry powder", "3 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tbsp palm sugar", "2 tbsp vegetable oil", "500 ml chicken stock or water", "Baguette, rice or rice noodles, to serve"]
steps: ["Pound the kroeung into a paste.", "Heat the oil and fry the kroeung and curry powder for 3 minutes until fragrant.", "Add the thick part of the coconut milk and cook until the oil separates.", "Add the chicken and stir for 5 minutes to coat it.", "Add the rest of the coconut milk and the stock, bring to a simmer and cook for 20 minutes.", "Add the sweet potatoes and potatoes and simmer for 20 minutes until almost tender.", "Add the onion, eggplant and long beans and cook for 10 minutes more.", "Season with fish sauce and palm sugar. Serve with baguette (num pang), rice or noodles."]

dish_name: Prahok ktiss
dish_name_kh: ប្រហុកខ្ទិះ
recipe_title: Prahok ktiss, pork and prahok coconut dip (ប្រហុកខ្ទិះ)
description: A rich dip of minced pork, prahok and coconut, eaten with raw vegetables and rice.
ingredients: ["200 g minced pork", "2 tbsp prahok (fermented fish paste), bones removed", "400 ml coconut milk", "2 tbsp kroeung (lemongrass, galangal, garlic, shallot and kaffir lime leaf, pounded)", "1 handful pea eggplants", "2 tbsp palm sugar", "1 tsp fish sauce", "3 kaffir lime leaves, torn", "3 red chillies, sliced (whole long chillies for a milder dip)", "Raw vegetables to dip: cucumber, cabbage, long beans, eggplant, carrot"]
steps: ["Simmer half the coconut milk in a pan until it thickens and the oil starts to show.", "Add the kroeung and fry for 2 minutes until fragrant.", "Add the minced pork and prahok, break them up and cook for 5 minutes.", "Add the rest of the coconut milk, the pea eggplants and the kaffir lime leaves, and simmer for 10–15 minutes until thick.", "Season with palm sugar and fish sauce (taste first: prahok is salty) and add the chillies.", "Serve warm as a dip with the raw vegetables and rice."]

dish_name: Sour soup (samlor machu)
dish_name_kh: សម្លម្ជូរត្រី
recipe_title: Samlor machu trey, sour fish soup (សម្លម្ជូរត្រី)
description: A light sour soup of tamarind, pineapple and tomato with fish and fresh herbs.
ingredients: ["400 g fish (catfish or snakehead), cut into pieces", "1.2 litres water", "2 tbsp tamarind pulp soaked in 100 ml warm water", "1 stalk lemongrass, bruised", "3 cloves garlic, crushed", "150 g pineapple, in chunks", "2 tomatoes, cut into wedges", "1 handful lotus stems or morning glory (optional)", "1 handful bean sprouts", "2 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tbsp sugar", "1 bunch rice paddy herb (ma-om) or holy basil, chopped", "Fried garlic and red chilli, to serve"]
steps: ["Bring the water to a boil with the lemongrass and garlic.", "Strain the tamarind water into the pot, add the pineapple and simmer for 5 minutes.", "Add the fish and simmer gently for 6–8 minutes until just cooked.", "Add the tomatoes and the lotus stems or morning glory and cook for 2 minutes.", "Season with fish sauce and sugar until it tastes sour, sweet and salty at once.", "Turn off the heat, add the bean sprouts and herbs, and top with fried garlic and chilli."]

dish_name: Sngao ngam ngov (soup with pickled lime)
dish_name_kh: ស្ងោរញាំញូវ
search: ស្ងោរញាំញូវ
recipe_title: Sngao chrouk ngam ngov, chicken soup with pickled lime (ស្ងោរញាំញូវ)
description: A clear chicken soup soured with salted pickled limes.
ingredients: ["1 chicken (about 1.2 kg), cut into pieces", "2 litres water", "3–4 salted pickled limes (ngam ngov) and a little of their brine", "1 bulb garlic, cloves peeled and lightly crushed", "1 thumb ginger, sliced (optional)", "1 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tsp sugar", "1 tsp salt", "Spring onions and coriander, chopped", "Fried garlic and ground black pepper, to serve"]
steps: ["Blanch the chicken in boiling water for 2 minutes, drain and rinse; this keeps the soup clear.", "Bring the fresh water to a boil with the garlic and ginger, add the chicken and simmer for 30 minutes, skimming the foam.", "Add the pickled limes and a little brine and simmer for 15 minutes more. Press the limes against the pot for more sourness.", "Season with fish sauce, sugar and salt; taste first, as the limes are salty.", "Serve topped with spring onion, coriander, fried garlic and pepper, with rice."]

dish_name: Stir-fried ginger (cha kney)
dish_name_kh: ឆាខ្ញីសាច់មាន់
recipe_title: Cha kney sach moan, chicken stir-fried with ginger (ឆាខ្ញីសាច់មាន់)
description: Chicken stir-fried with lots of young ginger, onion and oyster sauce.
ingredients: ["400 g chicken thigh, thinly sliced", "80 g young ginger, cut into thin matchsticks", "4 cloves garlic, minced", "1 onion, sliced", "4 dried wood-ear mushrooms, soaked and sliced (optional)", "2 tbsp oyster sauce", "1 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tbsp soy sauce", "1 tsp sugar", "3 tbsp water", "2 spring onions, cut into 4 cm pieces", "1 red chilli, sliced", "2 tbsp vegetable oil", "Ground black pepper"]
steps: ["Rinse the ginger matchsticks in salted water and squeeze them dry; this makes them less sharp.", "Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and fry the garlic until fragrant.", "Add the chicken and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes until almost cooked.", "Add the ginger, onion and mushrooms and stir-fry for 2 minutes.", "Add the oyster sauce, fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar and water and toss for 1 minute.", "Add the spring onion and chilli, sprinkle with pepper and serve with rice."]

dish_name: Salted crab (kdam prai)
dish_name_kh: ញាំក្តាមប្រៃ
recipe_title: Nhoam kdam prai, salted crab salad (ញាំក្តាមប្រៃ)
description: Small crabs cured in brine, then tossed with lime, garlic, chilli and basil. Eaten raw.
ingredients: ["500 g small rice-field or mangrove crabs, very fresh, scrubbed", "1 litre water", "150 g salt", "4 tbsp fish sauce", "2 tbsp sugar", "Juice of 3 limes", "6 cloves garlic, chopped", "4 bird's eye chillies, chopped", "1 handful Thai basil", "100 g long beans, cut short", "1 tomato, sliced", "1 small green papaya, shredded (optional)"]
steps: ["Dissolve the salt in the water, boil it and let it cool completely.", "Put the crabs in a jar, cover them with the cooled brine and keep them in the fridge for 24 hours (overnight at least).", "Drain the crabs, remove the top shell and gills and cut each crab in half.", "Mix the fish sauce, sugar, lime juice, garlic and chilli into a dressing.", "Toss the crabs with the dressing, long beans, tomato, papaya and basil, and let stand for 10 minutes.", "Serve with rice. The crab is eaten raw: use only very fresh crabs from a seller you trust."]

dish_name: Raw shrimp salad (plea bongkea)
dish_name_kh: ភ្លាបង្គា
recipe_title: Plea bongkea, lime-cured shrimp salad (ភ្លាបង្គា)
description: Prawns 'cooked' in lime juice, with lemongrass, herbs, chilli and peanuts.
ingredients: ["400 g very fresh prawns, peeled and butterflied (tails on)", "Juice of 5 limes", "3 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tbsp sugar", "4 cloves garlic, minced", "4 bird's eye chillies, chopped", "2 stalks lemongrass, very thinly sliced", "2 shallots, thinly sliced", "1 handful mint", "1 handful Thai basil", "1 cucumber or bitter melon, thinly sliced", "2 tbsp roasted peanuts, crushed"]
steps: ["Pour the juice of 3 limes over the prawns and leave for 10–15 minutes, until they turn pink-white; drain. (Many cooks blanch the prawns for 30 seconds first, to be safe.)", "Mix the fish sauce, sugar, remaining lime juice, garlic and chilli into a dressing.", "Lay the cucumber or bitter melon on a plate and the prawns on top.", "Scatter over the lemongrass, shallots, mint and basil and pour the dressing over.", "Top with the peanuts and serve right away."]

dish_name: Beef salad (plea sach ko)
dish_name_kh: ភ្លាសាច់គោ
recipe_title: Plea sach ko, lime-cured beef salad (ភ្លាសាច់គោ)
description: Thin slices of beef cured in lime juice, tossed with lemongrass, herbs and bean sprouts.
ingredients: ["400 g beef sirloin, sliced paper-thin", "Juice of 5 limes", "2 tbsp fish sauce (or 1 tbsp prahok juice)", "1 tbsp sugar", "3 cloves garlic, minced", "3 chillies, chopped", "2 stalks lemongrass, thinly sliced", "2 shallots, thinly sliced", "1 handful bean sprouts", "1 handful holy basil and mint", "1 small cucumber, sliced", "2 tbsp roasted peanuts, crushed", "1 tbsp toasted rice powder (optional)"]
steps: ["Toss the beef with the juice of 3 limes and leave for 10 minutes until it turns pale, then squeeze out the juice. (Some cooks sear the beef quickly first.)", "Mix the fish sauce, sugar, remaining lime juice, garlic and chilli into a dressing.", "Mix the beef with the lemongrass, shallots, bean sprouts, herbs and cucumber.", "Pour over the dressing, top with peanuts and rice powder, and serve with raw vegetables and rice."]

dish_name: Beef stew (sach ko kho)
dish_name_kh: សាច់គោខ
recipe_title: Sach ko kho, Khmer beef stew (សាច់គោខ)
description: Beef braised with lemongrass, star anise and tomato, served with bread or noodles.
ingredients: ["1 kg beef brisket or shank, cut into 4 cm pieces", "2 stalks lemongrass, bruised and cut", "4 cloves garlic, minced", "2 shallots, minced", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tsp five-spice powder", "3 star anise", "1 cinnamon stick", "3 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tbsp sugar", "1 tsp paprika or annatto oil, for colour", "1 litre coconut water or water", "3 carrots, cut into chunks", "2 tbsp vegetable oil", "Thai basil, sliced onion, baguette or rice noodles, to serve"]
steps: ["Mix the beef with the fish sauce, sugar, five-spice, garlic and shallots and marinate for 30 minutes.", "Heat the oil, fry the lemongrass, then brown the beef on all sides.", "Stir in the tomato paste and paprika for 2 minutes.", "Add the coconut water, star anise and cinnamon, bring to a boil and skim the foam.", "Cover and simmer for 90 minutes.", "Add the carrots and simmer for 25–30 minutes until the beef is tender.", "Adjust the seasoning and serve with baguette or noodles, basil and onion."]

dish_name: Vegetable soup (samlor proher)
dish_name_kh: សម្លប្រហើរ
recipe_title: Samlor proher, light Khmer vegetable soup (សម្លប្រហើរ)
description: A light soup of kroeung, pumpkin, gourd and leafy greens with fish or shrimp.
ingredients: ["300 g fish fillet or shrimp", "1.5 litres water", "2 tbsp kroeung (lemongrass, galangal, turmeric, garlic and shallot, pounded)", "1 tbsp prahok (optional)", "200 g pumpkin, cubed", "1 sponge gourd (luffa), peeled and sliced", "1 bunch leafy greens (moringa, sweet leaf or spinach)", "1 handful mushrooms (optional)", "2 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tsp sugar", "1 tbsp vegetable oil"]
steps: ["Fry the kroeung and prahok in the oil for 2 minutes until fragrant.", "Add the water and bring to a boil. Add the pumpkin and simmer for 10 minutes.", "Add the gourd and mushrooms and simmer for 5 minutes.", "Add the fish or shrimp and cook for 4–5 minutes.", "Season with fish sauce and sugar, add the greens, cook for 1–2 minutes and serve with rice."]

dish_name: Steamed fish with soy sauce
dish_name_kh: ត្រីចំហុយទឹកស៊ីអ៊ីវ
recipe_title: Trei chamhoy teuk si-iv, steamed fish with soy sauce (ត្រីចំហុយទឹកស៊ីអ៊ីវ)
description: A whole fish steamed with ginger, finished with soy sauce and sizzling oil.
ingredients: ["1 whole fish (about 700 g: tilapia, snakehead or sea bass), cleaned", "5 cm ginger: half sliced, half cut into thin matchsticks", "3 spring onions: whites cut into pieces, greens into thin strips", "3 tbsp light soy sauce", "1 tbsp oyster sauce", "1 tsp sugar", "3 tbsp hot water", "2 tbsp vegetable oil", "1 red chilli, cut into thin strips", "Coriander, to garnish"]
steps: ["Cut 2–3 slashes on each side of the fish. Put the ginger slices and spring-onion whites inside and under it on a heatproof plate.", "Steam over boiling water for 12–15 minutes, until the flesh flakes.", "Meanwhile, mix the soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar and hot water.", "Pour off the steaming liquid, pour the sauce over the fish and top with the ginger matchsticks, spring-onion greens and chilli.", "Heat the oil until smoking and pour it over the toppings so they sizzle. Garnish with coriander and serve with rice."]

dish_name: Kuy teav (noodle soup)
dish_name_kh: គុយទាវ
recipe_title: Kuy teav, Phnom Penh pork noodle soup (គុយទាវ)
description: Rice noodles in a clear pork broth, with sliced pork, bean sprouts, herbs and garlic oil.
ingredients: ["1 kg pork bones", "300 g pork loin (or pork balls)", "2.5 litres water", "50 g dried shrimp", "1 small dried squid, toasted (optional)", "1 daikon, peeled and cut in chunks", "1 onion, charred", "1 tbsp rock sugar", "2 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tsp salt", "400 g dried flat rice noodles", "Bean sprouts, spring onion, coriander, garlic oil", "Lime wedges, chilli and hoisin sauce, to serve"]
steps: ["Blanch the pork bones in boiling water for 5 minutes, drain and rinse.", "Put the bones in the fresh water with the dried shrimp, squid, daikon and onion. Simmer gently for 1½–2 hours, skimming the foam.", "Season the broth with rock sugar, fish sauce and salt. Poach the pork loin in it for 15 minutes, then slice it thinly.", "Soak the noodles in warm water for 20 minutes, then blanch each portion for 30 seconds.", "Put bean sprouts and noodles in each bowl, top with the pork and ladle over the hot broth.", "Finish with garlic oil, spring onion and coriander. Serve with lime, chilli and hoisin."]

dish_name: Bai sach chrouk (pork and rice)
dish_name_kh: បាយសាច់ជ្រូក
recipe_title: Bai sach chrouk, grilled pork and rice (បាយសាច់ជ្រូក)
description: The Khmer breakfast: sweet coconut-marinated grilled pork on rice with quick pickles.
ingredients: ["600 g pork shoulder or neck, thinly sliced", "4 cloves garlic, minced", "3 tbsp coconut milk", "2 tbsp palm sugar", "2 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tbsp soy sauce", "½ tsp ground black pepper", "Steamed rice", "Pickles (chruok): 1 cucumber and 1 carrot, thinly sliced; 4 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar, ½ tsp salt", "Clear broth with spring onion, to serve"]
steps: ["Marinate the pork with the garlic, coconut milk, palm sugar, fish sauce, soy sauce and pepper for at least 1 hour, or overnight in the fridge.", "Make the pickles: mix the cucumber and carrot with the vinegar, sugar and salt and leave for 30 minutes.", "Grill the pork over medium charcoal heat for 3–4 minutes per side, brushing with the marinade, until caramelised.", "Slice the pork and serve over rice with the pickles and a small bowl of clear broth."]

dish_name: Samlor machu kroeung (sour beef soup with kroeung)
dish_name_kh: សម្លម្ជូរគ្រឿងសាច់គោ
recipe_title: Samlor machu kroeung sach ko, sour beef soup with kroeung (សម្លម្ជូរគ្រឿងសាច់គោ)
description: Hearty sour beef and water spinach soup flavoured with lemongrass kroeung, tamarind and prahok.
ingredients: ["Kroeung: 2 stalks lemongrass, thinly sliced, 3 cm galangal, sliced, 3 cm fresh turmeric (or 1 tsp ground), 4 kaffir lime leaves, stems removed, 4 cloves garlic, 3 shallots", "400 g beef ribs or shank, cut into bite-sized pieces", "1 tbsp prahok (fermented fish paste)", "2 tbsp tamarind pulp soaked in 100 ml warm water and strained", "1 bunch water spinach (trakuon), cut into 5 cm pieces", "2 Thai eggplants, quartered", "1.2 litres water", "2 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tbsp palm sugar", "1 tbsp vegetable oil"]
steps: ["Pound the kroeung ingredients into a fine aromatic paste.", "Heat the oil in a large pot and fry the kroeung and prahok for 2–3 minutes until fragrant.", "Add the beef pieces and sear until browned on all sides.", "Pour in the water, bring to a boil, skim off foam, and simmer gently for 30 minutes until beef is tender.", "Pour in the strained tamarind juice and add the eggplants; simmer for 8 minutes.", "Add the water spinach, season with fish sauce and palm sugar, and cook for 2 minutes.", "Serve hot with steamed jasmine rice."]

dish_name: Samlor machu ktis (coconut sour soup)
dish_name_kh: សម្លម្ជូរខ្ទិះ
recipe_title: Samlor machu ktis, sour coconut pork ribs soup (សម្លម្ជូរខ្ទិះ)
description: A rich and tangy soup of pork ribs, coconut milk, red kroeung, pineapple and morning glory.
ingredients: ["Kroeung: 2 stalks lemongrass, thinly sliced, 3 cm galangal, sliced, 3 cm fresh turmeric (or 1 tsp ground), 4 kaffir lime leaves, stems removed, 4 cloves garlic, 3 shallots, 5 dried red chillies, soaked", "400 g pork spare ribs, chopped into small bite-sized pieces", "400 ml coconut milk", "500 ml water", "1 tbsp prahok (fermented fish paste)", "150 g fresh pineapple, cut into chunks", "1 bunch morning glory or lotus stems, cut short", "2 tbsp tamarind pulp soaked and strained", "2 tbsp palm sugar", "2 tbsp fish sauce", "3 red bird's eye chillies"]
steps: ["Heat 150 ml of thick coconut milk in a pot until the coconut oil begins to separate.", "Add the red kroeung and prahok, frying for 2 minutes until rich and fragrant.", "Add the pork ribs, stirring to coat with the paste and browning slightly.", "Pour in the remaining coconut milk and water, bring to a simmer, and cook for 25 minutes until ribs are tender.", "Add the pineapple chunks and tamarind juice; simmer gently for 5 minutes.", "Add the morning glory, season with palm sugar and fish sauce, and drop in the chillies.", "Simmer for 2 minutes more and serve hot with jasmine rice."]

dish_name: Sngor chruok moan (sour chicken soup with holy basil)
dish_name_kh: ស្ងោរជ្រក់មាន់
recipe_title: Sngor chruok moan, lime & lemongrass sour chicken soup (ស្ងោរជ្រក់មាន់)
description: Classic light sour chicken soup infused with bruised lemongrass, fresh lime juice and holy basil.
ingredients: ["500 g chicken thighs or wings on the bone, chopped into chunks", "1.2 litres water or light chicken stock", "2 stalks lemongrass, bruised and cut into sections", "3 kaffir lime leaves, torn", "1 thumb galangal, sliced", "4 cloves garlic, crushed", "3 shallots, crushed", "3 tbsp fresh lime juice", "2 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tsp sugar", "1 handful fresh holy basil leaves", "3 bird's eye chillies, lightly crushed", "1 tbsp fried garlic in oil, to garnish"]
steps: ["Bring the water to a boil with lemongrass, galangal, garlic, shallots and kaffir lime leaves for 5 minutes to release the fragrance.", "Add the chicken pieces and simmer gently on medium heat for 20 minutes, skimming off any foam.", "Season the soup with fish sauce and sugar.", "Turn off the heat before stirring in the fresh lime juice, crushed chillies, and holy basil leaves (lime turns bitter if boiled).", "Top each bowl with crispy fried garlic and serve steaming hot with rice."]

dish_name: Teuk kroeung (fish dipping sauce with fresh vegetables)
dish_name_kh: ទឹកគ្រឿង
recipe_title: Teuk kroeung, poached fish and herb dipping sauce (ទឹកគ្រឿង)
description: Traditional pounded fish dip seasoned with kroeung and fermented fish, eaten with a lush platter of raw river greens.
ingredients: ["300 g white freshwater fish fillet (catfish or snakehead)", "Kroeung: 2 stalks lemongrass, 2 cm galangal, 1 thumb turmeric, 4 cloves garlic, 3 shallots", "1 tbsp prahok, boiled in 100 ml water and strained", "2 tbsp roasted pea eggplants", "2 tbsp roasted peanuts, crushed", "2 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tbsp palm sugar", "Juice of 2 limes", "Fresh vegetables to serve: water lily stems, winged beans, cucumber, green eggplant, banana blossoms"]
steps: ["Poach the fish fillet in gently simmering water for 8 minutes until cooked through; drain and flake the meat.", "Lightly roast the garlic and shallots in a dry pan, then pound with lemongrass, galangal and turmeric into a paste.", "Add the flaked fish meat and pea eggplants into the mortar, pounding into a thick textured blend.", "Transfer to a bowl and whisk in the strained warm prahok liquid, lime juice, fish sauce and palm sugar.", "Fold in the crushed roasted peanuts.", "Serve in a dipping bowl surrounded by an abundant platter of fresh raw river greens and vegetables."]

dish_name: Cha kdam kchey (Kampot green pepper crab)
dish_name_kh: ក្តាមឆាម្រេចខ្ចី
recipe_title: Cha kdam kchey, blue swimming crab stir-fried with fresh Kampot peppercorns (ក្តាមឆាម្រេចខ្ចី)
description: World-famous coastal Cambodian delicacy: sweet sea crab wok-fried with fiery bunches of fresh green Kampot pepper.
ingredients: ["2 fresh blue swimming crabs (about 600 g), cleaned, quartered and claws cracked", "4–5 whole sprigs fresh green Kampot peppercorns", "5 cloves garlic, minced", "2 spring onions, cut into 4 cm pieces", "2 tbsp oyster sauce", "1 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tbsp light soy sauce", "1 tsp palm sugar", "3 tbsp water", "2 tbsp vegetable oil"]
steps: ["Clean the crabs, discard the spongy gills, chop bodies into quarters, and gently crack the claws with the back of a cleaver.", "Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and fry the garlic and sprigs of green Kampot peppercorns until intensely aromatic.", "Add the crab pieces and stir-fry briskly for 3–4 minutes until the shells blush bright orange-red.", "Mix the oyster sauce, fish sauce, soy sauce, palm sugar and water; pour over the crabs in the wok.", "Cover the wok with a lid for 2–3 minutes to steam the sweet crab meat thoroughly.", "Toss in the spring onions, give a final high-heat toss for 30 seconds, and transfer to a platter with rice."]

dish_name: Cha trop dot (charred eggplant with pork)
dish_name_kh: ឆាត្រប់ដុតសាច់ជ្រូកចិញ្ច្រាំ
recipe_title: Cha trop dot, smoky charred eggplant with minced pork (ឆាត្រប់ដុតសាច់ជ្រូកចិញ្ច្រាំ)
description: Smoky charcoal-roasted eggplant tossed with savoury minced pork, garlic and oyster sauce.
ingredients: ["3 long Asian purple eggplants", "250 g minced pork", "4 cloves garlic, minced", "2 spring onions, chopped", "2 tbsp oyster sauce", "1 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tbsp soy sauce", "1 tsp sugar", "½ tsp ground Kampot black pepper", "2 tbsp vegetable oil"]
steps: ["Grill whole eggplants over hot charcoal (or roast under an oven broiler) for 12–15 minutes until skins are blackened and flesh is completely tender.", "Peel off the charred skins, gently shred the tender eggplant flesh into strips and arrange on a serving platter.", "Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat and fry the minced garlic until golden.", "Add the minced pork and stir-fry, breaking up clumps, until fully cooked through.", "Add the oyster sauce, fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar and black pepper, stirring for 1 minute until glazed.", "Pour the hot savoury minced pork and pan juices directly over the roasted eggplant strips.", "Garnish with chopped spring onions and serve immediately with warm rice."]

dish_name: Cha kroeung sach ko (lemongrass stir-fried beef)
dish_name_kh: ឆាគ្រឿងសាច់គោ
recipe_title: Cha kroeung sach ko, beef stir-fried with red kroeung & holy basil (ឆាគ្រឿងសាច់គោ)
description: Thin beef slices flash-fried with fragrant lemongrass kroeung, roasted peanuts, long beans, and holy basil.
ingredients: ["350 g beef sirloin or flank, thinly sliced across the grain", "Kroeung: 2 stalks lemongrass, thinly sliced, 3 cm galangal, sliced, 3 cm fresh turmeric (or 1 tsp ground), 4 kaffir lime leaves, stems removed, 4 cloves garlic, 3 shallots, 5 dried red chillies, soaked", "100 g yardlong beans, cut into 3 cm pieces", "½ red bell pepper, thinly sliced", "1 handful holy basil leaves", "2 tbsp roasted peanuts, crushed", "2 tbsp oyster sauce", "1 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tbsp palm sugar", "2 tbsp vegetable oil"]
steps: ["Pound the red kroeung into a fragrant paste.", "Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat and sauté the red kroeung for 2 minutes until aromatic.", "Increase the heat to high, add the sliced beef, and stir-fry vigorously for 2 minutes.", "Add the yardlong beans and sliced bell pepper, stir-frying for 2 minutes until crisp-tender.", "Season with oyster sauce, fish sauce and palm sugar, tossing well.", "Fold in the fresh holy basil leaves and crushed peanuts, toss for 30 seconds, and serve hot with rice."]

dish_name: Prahok ang (grilled prahok in banana leaves)
dish_name_kh: ប្រហុកអាំងស្លឹកចេក
recipe_title: Prahok ang, grilled fermented fish with minced pork in banana leaves (ប្រហុកអាំងស្លឹកចេក)
description: Savory fermented fish blended with minced pork belly, shallots, garlic, and chillies, grilled in smoky banana leaves.
ingredients: ["100 g quality prahok (fermented fish paste), finely minced", "150 g pork belly, minced", "4 shallots, minced", "5 cloves garlic, minced", "3 bird's eye chillies, finely chopped", "2 kaffir lime leaves, thinly sliced", "1 tbsp palm sugar", "Banana leaves, cut into squares and warmed over flame until pliable", "To serve: cucumber, raw cabbage, green mango slices, yardlong beans, steamed rice"]
steps: ["In a mixing bowl, combine the minced prahok, pork belly, shallots, garlic, chillies, kaffir lime leaves and palm sugar.", "Mix thoroughly with a fork until the mixture forms a uniform seasoned paste.", "Place 2–3 tablespoons of mixture onto double-layered banana leaf squares, fold into flat rectangular parcels, and secure with toothpicks.", "Grill the parcels over hot charcoal embers (or in a dry cast-iron skillet) for 8–10 minutes per side until charred on the outside and fragrant within.", "Unwrap the hot parcel and serve alongside fresh crunchy raw vegetables, green mango, and warm steamed rice."]

dish_name: Bok lahong (Khmer green papaya salad)
dish_name_kh: បុកល្ហុង
recipe_title: Bok lahong, pounded Khmer green papaya salad with salted crab (បុកល្ហុង)
description: Tangy, savoury, and fiery pounded green papaya salad with salted field crab, dried shrimp, lime and prahok.
ingredients: ["2 cups unripened green papaya, peeled and shredded", "2 salted field crabs (kdam prai), cleaned and halved", "2 tbsp dried shrimp", "3 cloves garlic", "3 bird's eye chillies", "2 yardlong beans, snapped into short pieces", "4 cherry tomatoes, halved", "Juice of 2 limes", "1 tbsp tamarind pulp liquid", "1½ tbsp palm sugar", "1½ tbsp fish sauce (or 1 tsp boiled prahok juice)", "2 tbsp roasted peanuts"]
steps: ["In a large clay mortar, pound the garlic, chillies and dried shrimp with a wooden pestle until crushed.", "Add the snapped long beans and salted field crab halves, bruising gently with the pestle.", "Add the palm sugar, tamarind liquid, lime juice and fish sauce; stir and pound lightly until the sugar completely dissolves.", "Add the shredded green papaya and cherry tomatoes, pounding while tossing with a large spoon for 1–2 minutes so the papaya absorbs the seasoning.", "Scatter over the roasted peanuts and serve with fresh cabbage wedges and crispy pork cracklings."]

dish_name: Nhoam svay kchey (green mango salad with smoked fish)
dish_name_kh: ញាំស្វាយខ្ចីត្រីឆ្អើរ
recipe_title: Nhoam svay kchey trey chhae, tart green mango salad with smoked fish (ញាំស្វាយខ្ចីត្រីឆ្អើរ)
description: Crisp shredded sour green mango tossed with flaked smoked river fish, shallots, mint and sweet fish sauce.
ingredients: ["2 firm tart green mangoes, peeled and finely shredded", "100 g smoked river fish (trey chhae), skin removed and flaked", "3 shallots, thinly sliced", "1 handful fresh mint leaves", "1 handful Asian basil or fish mint", "2 bird's eye chillies, sliced", "2 tbsp fish sauce", "2 tbsp palm sugar", "Juice of 1 lime", "2 tbsp roasted peanuts, crushed"]
steps: ["Toast the flaked smoked fish in a dry frying pan over medium heat for 3 minutes until warm, fragrant and lightly crisp.", "In a small bowl, whisk the fish sauce, palm sugar and lime juice until the sugar is fully dissolved.", "In a large salad bowl, combine the shredded green mango, smoked fish, sliced shallots, chillies, mint and basil leaves.", "Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss gently to coat evenly.", "Sprinkle with crushed roasted peanuts and serve right away as a refreshing side dish."]

dish_name: Lort cha (stir-fried silver needle noodles)
dish_name_kh: លតឆា
recipe_title: Lort cha sach ko, stir-fried rice pin noodles with beef and egg (លតឆា)
description: Classic Cambodian street-cart dish: short rice pin noodles wok-fried with beef, garlic chives, bean sprouts, topped with a fried egg.
ingredients: ["300 g fresh rice pin noodles (lort)", "150 g beef sirloin, thinly sliced", "1 cup bean sprouts", "1 bunch Chinese garlic chives, cut into 4 cm pieces", "2 eggs", "3 cloves garlic, minced", "1½ tbsp dark sweet soy sauce", "1 tbsp light soy sauce", "1 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tsp sugar", "2 tbsp vegetable oil", "Sweet pickled red chilli sauce, to serve"]
steps: ["Mix the dark sweet soy sauce, light soy sauce, fish sauce and sugar in a small prep bowl.", "Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok and fry 2 sunny-side-up eggs until crispy around the edges; set eggs aside.", "Add remaining oil to the hot wok, sauté the garlic until fragrant, add the sliced beef and stir-fry for 1 minute.", "Add the fresh pin noodles and the sauce mixture; stir-fry vigorously over high heat for 2 minutes until glossy.", "Toss in the bean sprouts and garlic chives, tossing for 30 seconds so they stay crunchy.", "Transfer to plates, crown each with a crispy fried egg, and serve with sweet chilli dipping sauce."]

dish_name: Mee kola (Battambang Kola-style noodles)
dish_name_kh: មីកូឡា
recipe_title: Mee kola, Battambang steamed noodles with dried shrimp and pickles (មីកូឡា)
description: Heritage noodle dish from Battambang: steamed noodles tossed in dark soy dressing, topped with crispy tofu, boiled eggs, dried shrimp, and pickles.
ingredients: ["250 g dried rice vermicelli or thin egg noodles", "100 g firm tofu, cut into cubes and fried crisp", "2 hard-boiled eggs, halved", "3 tbsp dried shrimp, toasted and pounded into fine floss", "1 cup pickled cucumber and carrot ribbons (chruok)", "1 cup shredded lettuce", "2 tbsp dark sweet soy sauce", "1 tbsp light soy sauce", "1 tbsp garlic oil", "2 tbsp roasted peanuts, crushed", "Sweet dressing: 3 tbsp fish sauce, 3 tbsp palm sugar, 2 tbsp lime juice, 2 cloves minced garlic, 1 red chilli"]
steps: ["Cook noodles in boiling water until just tender, drain well, and toss with garlic oil and dark soy sauce.", "Whisk the fish sauce, palm sugar, lime juice, minced garlic and chilli into a sweet dressing.", "Arrange shredded lettuce in serving bowls and mound the dark glistening noodles on top.", "Arrange the crispy fried tofu cubes, halved boiled eggs, and pickled vegetables neatly around the noodles.", "Sprinkle generously with pounded dried shrimp floss and crushed roasted peanuts.", "Drizzle with the sweet dressing and toss together before eating."]

dish_name: Num pang pate (Cambodian baguette sandwich)
dish_name_kh: នំប៉័ងប៉ាតេ
recipe_title: Num pang pate, crusty baguette with rich pork pâté and pickles (នំប៉័ងប៉ាតេ)
description: Cambodian crusty baguette loaded with rich pork pâté, mayonnaise, Asian cold cuts, crunchy pickled green papaya, and spicy chilli.
ingredients: ["2 fresh Cambodian baguettes (crispy crust, light airy crumb)", "4 tbsp rich pork liver pâté", "2 tbsp mayonnaise", "100 g sliced Cambodian/Vietnamese pork roll (cha lua)", "½ cup pickled green papaya and carrot (chruok)", "1 cucumber, sliced into long ribbons", "Fresh coriander sprigs", "2 bird's eye chillies, sliced", "A few dashes Maggi liquid seasoning"]
steps: ["Warm baguettes in a 200°C oven for 3–4 minutes until the exterior crust is crackly and crisp.", "Slice each baguette lengthwise down the side, leaving the back attached.", "Spread rich pork liver pâté generously on one side and creamy mayonnaise on the other.", "Layer in the sliced pork roll, cucumber ribbons, and a hearty portion of drained pickled papaya and carrot.", "Tuck in fresh coriander sprigs and fresh sliced chillies.", "Finish with a few dashes of Maggi seasoning sauce, press closed, and cut diagonally to serve."]

dish_name: Bai moan Siem Reap (Cambodian chicken rice)
dish_name_kh: បាយមាន់សៀមរាប
search: bai moan siem reap chicken rice
recipe_title: Bai moan Siem Reap, fragrant poached chicken rice with ginger sauce (បាយមាន់សៀមរាប)
description: Aromatic jasmine rice cooked in rich chicken stock and garlic, served with poached local chicken and fiery ginger-lime sauce.
ingredients: ["1 whole chicken (about 1.2 kg), cut into large sections", "2 cups jasmine rice, rinsed and drained", "4 cloves garlic, minced", "2 shallots, sliced", "2 thumbs ginger (half sliced, half finely grated)", "2 pandan leaves, tied in a knot", "1 tbsp chicken fat or oil", "1 tbsp fish sauce", "Cucumber slices and coriander, to serve", "Ginger sauce: 3 tbsp grated ginger, 2 tbsp fish sauce, 2 tbsp lime juice, 1 tbsp palm sugar, 2 cloves minced garlic, 2 chillies"]
steps: ["Bring 2 litres water to a boil with sliced ginger and shallots; submerge the chicken and simmer gently for 25 minutes until tender. Remove chicken and keep the rich broth.", "Heat chicken fat or oil in a pan, fry minced garlic and the raw rice for 3 minutes until grains turn chalky white.", "Transfer rice to a cooker with pandan leaves, 2½ cups of the hot chicken broth, and a pinch of salt; cook until fluffy.", "Whisk the grated ginger, fish sauce, lime juice, palm sugar, garlic and chillies into a pungent dipping sauce.", "Chop the chicken into pieces, arrange over the fragrant chicken rice with sliced cucumbers, and serve with hot broth and ginger sauce."]

dish_name: Num banh chok Kampot (Kampot-style sweet noodle salad)
dish_name_kh: នំបញ្ចុកទឹកត្រីផ្អែមកំពត
recipe_title: Num banh chok teuk trey ph'em, Kampot dry noodle salad (នំបញ្ចុកទឹកត្រីផ្អែមកំពត)
description: Refreshing southern specialty: fresh rice noodles served dry with warm sweet fish sauce dressing, ground dried shrimp, crispy spring rolls and cucumber.
ingredients: ["500 g fresh fermented rice noodles (num banh chok)", "4 crispy fried spring rolls (cha yor), sliced into bite-sized rounds", "4 tbsp dried shrimp, toasted and ground into powder", "1 cup finely sliced cucumber", "1 cup fresh bean sprouts", "½ cup fresh mint and Thai basil leaves", "3 tbsp roasted peanuts, crushed", "Sweet dressing: ½ cup warm water, 3 tbsp fish sauce, 3 tbsp palm sugar, 2 tbsp lime juice, 2 cloves minced garlic, 2 red chillies"]
steps: ["Whisk warm water and palm sugar until dissolved, then stir in fish sauce, lime juice, minced garlic and chillies to make the sweet dressing.", "Refresh the rice noodles in warm water, drain thoroughly, and divide among 4 bowls.", "Layer sliced cucumber, bean sprouts, and fresh mint/basil over the noodles.", "Top each bowl with crispy sliced spring rolls, ground dried shrimp powder, and crushed peanuts.", "Spoon 3–4 tablespoons of sweet dressing over each bowl and toss before eating."]

dish_name: Sach ko ang jakak (grilled lemongrass beef skewers)
dish_name_kh: សាច់គោអាំងចង្កាក់
recipe_title: Sach ko ang jakak, grilled lemongrass beef skewers with papaya pickles (សាច់គោអាំងចង្កាក់)
description: Street food staple: tender beef marinated in yellow lemongrass kroeung and coconut milk, char-grilled on bamboo skewers.
ingredients: ["600 g beef sirloin or flank, cut into thin strips", "Kroeung: 2 stalks lemongrass, thinly sliced, 3 cm galangal, sliced, 3 cm fresh turmeric (or 1 tsp ground), 4 kaffir lime leaves, stems removed, 4 cloves garlic, 3 shallots", "2 tbsp coconut milk", "2 tbsp oyster sauce", "1½ tbsp fish sauce", "1½ tbsp palm sugar", "1 tbsp vegetable oil", "16 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes", "To serve: pickled green papaya (chruok lahong) and crusty baguette"]
steps: ["Pound the yellow kroeung into a paste and mix with coconut milk, oyster sauce, fish sauce, palm sugar and oil in a bowl.", "Add the sliced beef, massage the marinade into the meat thoroughly, and refrigerate for at least 1–2 hours.", "Thread the beef slices zigzag-style onto soaked bamboo skewers.", "Prepare a charcoal grill to medium-high heat (or heat a ridged grill pan).", "Grill the skewers for 3–4 minutes per side, brushing with remaining marinade, until nicely charred and caramelised.", "Serve hot straight off the grill with crunchy pickled green papaya and crusty baguette."]

dish_name: Sankhya lapov (steamed pumpkin custard)
dish_name_kh: សង់ខ្យាល្ពៅ
recipe_title: Sankhya lapov, steamed pumpkin with coconut palm-sugar custard (សង់ខ្យាល្ពៅ)
description: Whole sweet Japanese kabocha pumpkin filled with rich palm sugar and coconut egg custard, steamed until tender.
ingredients: ["1 whole medium kabocha pumpkin (about 1.2 kg)", "4 large duck or chicken eggs", "200 ml thick coconut cream", "120 g Cambodian palm sugar, finely shaved", "¼ tsp salt", "2 pandan leaves, tied in a knot"]
steps: ["Carefully cut a circular lid from the top of the pumpkin; scoop out the seeds and stringy pulp with a spoon, rinse and pat dry.", "In a bowl, gently whisk the eggs, shaved palm sugar, salt and pandan leaves with your fingers until the sugar dissolves completely.", "Stir in the thick coconut cream and strain the custard mixture through a fine sieve into the hollowed pumpkin, leaving 1 cm space at top.", "Place the filled pumpkin in a heatproof bowl and set inside a steamer over boiling water.", "Steam over medium heat for 45–50 minutes until custard is set (a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean).", "Allow to cool completely to room temperature (or chill in the fridge) before slicing into neat cake-like wedges."]

dish_name: Num kom (pyramid sticky rice cakes with sweet coconut)
dish_name_kh: នំគម
recipe_title: Num kom, steamed glutinous rice cakes filled with sweet coconut (នំគម)
description: Ceremonial festival sweet: tender glutinous rice dough encasing a fragrant filling of caramelized coconut and toasted sesame, steamed in banana leaf pyramids.
ingredients: ["Dough: 300 g glutinous rice flour, 220 ml warm water, 1 tbsp sugar, ½ tsp salt", "Filling: 1½ cups freshly grated coconut, 120 g palm sugar, 2 tbsp toasted white sesame seeds, 3 tbsp water", "Wrappers: fresh banana leaves cut into 18x18 cm squares and softened, 2 tbsp vegetable oil"]
steps: ["Make filling: melt palm sugar with water in a pan, add grated coconut, and stir over medium heat for 8 minutes until glossy; fold in sesame seeds and roll into small 2 cm balls.", "Make dough: mix glutinous rice flour, sugar, salt and warm water, kneading into a smooth pliable dough; divide into balls equal to filling balls.", "Flatten each dough ball with your palm, place a coconut filling ball in center, seal dough completely around it, and roll smooth.", "Brush banana leaf with oil, fold into a cone, insert a filled dumpling, and fold flaps over into a neat pyramid parcel.", "Steam the parcels over boiling water for 25 minutes until cooked through; allow to cool slightly before serving."]

dish_name: Num ansorm chek (sticky rice cake with banana)
dish_name_kh: នំអន្សមចេក
recipe_title: Num ansorm chek, steamed sticky rice cylindrical cake with ripe banana (នំអន្សមចេក)
description: Pchum Ben festival essential: sticky rice seasoned with coconut milk and beans, wrapped around sweet baby bananas in banana leaves and boiled.
ingredients: ["500 g glutinous rice, soaked in water for 4 hours and drained", "200 ml thick coconut milk", "8 small ripe baby bananas (chek namva)", "½ cup cooked black beans or yellow mung beans", "1 tsp salt", "2 tbsp sugar", "Banana leaves, cleaned and softened over flame", "Cotton kitchen twine for tying"]
steps: ["Toss the soaked glutinous rice with coconut milk, sugar, salt and cooked beans until evenly coated.", "Peel the ripe bananas and lightly dust them with a pinch of sugar.", "Lay overlapping banana leaves flat; spread a layer of seasoned sticky rice in the center and place a banana lengthwise on top.", "Cover with more sticky rice so the banana is completely enveloped.", "Roll the banana leaves tightly into a cylindrical log, fold both ends inward, and tie securely with kitchen twine at 2 cm intervals.", "Submerge logs in a deep pot of boiling water, cover tightly, and simmer on medium heat for 3 hours, adding hot water as needed.", "Remove, drain, and let cool completely before slicing into rounds."]

dish_name: Num plae ai (glutinous rice balls with molten palm sugar)
dish_name_kh: នំផ្លែអាយ
recipe_title: Num plae ai, sweet sticky rice balls with molten palm sugar core (នំផ្លែអាយ)
description: Delightful street sweet: chewy boiled rice balls bursting with molten liquid palm sugar, tossed in freshly grated coconut.
ingredients: ["250 g glutinous rice flour", "180 ml warm water", "100 g hard Cambodian palm sugar, cut into 1 cm cubes", "1 cup freshly grated coconut (unsweetened)", "¼ tsp salt"]
steps: ["Toss the grated coconut with salt and steam for 3 minutes to keep fresh, then spread onto a wide plate.", "Gradually add warm water to the glutinous rice flour, kneading until a smooth non-sticky dough forms.", "Pinch off a small portion of dough (2 cm), flatten with fingers, place a cube of palm sugar in the center, seal tightly and roll into a smooth sphere.", "Bring a pot of water to a rolling boil and drop the rice balls in.", "Cook until they float to the surface, then boil 2 more minutes to ensure the palm sugar core melts into liquid syrup.", "Lift out with a slotted spoon, roll immediately in the grated coconut until coated, and serve warm."]

dish_name: Cha houy teuk (Khmer sweet jelly and coconut iced dessert)
dish_name_kh: ចាហួយទឹក
recipe_title: Cha houy teuk, iced coconut dessert with agar jelly and sweet beans (ចាហួយទឹក)
description: Colorful iced refresher: translucent agar-agar jelly cubes, sweet red beans, tapioca pearls, sweetened coconut milk, and shaved ice.
ingredients: ["1 packet (10 g) agar-agar powder", "750 ml water", "3 tbsp sugar", "2 drops pandan extract or green colour", "1 cup cooked sweet red beans", "½ cup cooked small tapioca pearls", "250 ml thick coconut milk simmered with ¼ tsp salt", "½ cup palm sugar syrup", "Crushed or shaved ice"]
steps: ["Dissolve agar-agar powder and sugar in water, bring to a boil while stirring constantly.", "Stir in pandan extract, pour into a flat dish, and chill in the fridge for 30 minutes until set; cut into small cubes.", "In serving glasses or bowls, layer agar jelly cubes, sweet red beans, and cooked tapioca pearls.", "Drizzle with warm salted coconut cream and rich palm sugar syrup.", "Heap crushed or shaved ice on top and serve immediately with a spoon."]

dish_name: Banh ja'neuk (sticky rice dumplings in sweet ginger syrup)
dish_name_kh: បាញ់ចានឿក
recipe_title: Banh ja'neuk, glutinous rice dumplings in warm ginger syrup (បាញ់ចានឿក)
description: Comforting dessert: soft mung-bean-stuffed rice dumplings floating in hot aromatic ginger syrup with coconut cream.
ingredients: ["Dough: 200 g glutinous rice flour, 150 ml warm water", "Filling: 100 g yellow split mung beans (soaked 2 hours, steamed tender, mashed with 2 tbsp sugar, ¼ tsp salt)", "Ginger syrup: 150 g palm sugar, 500 ml water, 5 cm fresh ginger sliced and bruised", "Topping: 150 ml coconut cream simmered with 1 tsp cornstarch and pinch of salt, 1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds"]
steps: ["Roll the seasoned mashed mung bean filling into 10 small round balls.", "Knead glutinous rice flour with warm water into a smooth dough; wrap dough around mung bean balls and roll smooth.", "Make syrup: boil water, palm sugar and ginger slices for 10 minutes until fragrant and amber-coloured.", "Boil the dumplings in a pot of water until they float; cook 2 minutes more, then transfer into the simmering ginger syrup.", "Simmer dumplings in the syrup for 5 minutes to absorb flavour.", "Ladle into bowls with hot ginger syrup, spoon salted coconut cream over top, and scatter toasted sesame seeds."]

dish_name: Khor trey (clay-pot caramelised fish)
dish_name_kh: ខត្រីពងទា
recipe_title: Khor trey, caramelised clay-pot braised fish with eggs and pepper (ខត្រីពងទា)
description: Tender freshwater fish steaks and boiled eggs slowly simmered in rich palm sugar caramel and Kampot pepper.
ingredients: ["500 g freshwater fish steaks (snakehead, catfish or mackerel)", "4 hard-boiled eggs, peeled", "3 tbsp palm sugar", "3 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tbsp dark soy sauce", "4 cloves garlic, crushed", "1 tsp crushed Kampot black pepper", "400 ml fresh coconut water", "2 spring onions, chopped", "2 red chillies, whole"]
steps: ["Melt palm sugar in a clay pot or heavy pot over medium heat until it bubbles into a deep dark amber caramel.", "Add crushed garlic, then add fish steaks, searing for 2 minutes to coat with the caramel glaze.", "Add fish sauce, dark soy sauce, and black pepper; pour in coconut water and bring to a boil.", "Add peeled hard-boiled eggs and whole chillies; reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 30 minutes until sauce is dark and glossy.", "Scatter chopped spring onions over top and serve hot with steamed rice and cucumber slices."]

dish_name: Cha spey kdov (stir-fried water spinach with garlic)
dish_name_kh: ឆាត្រកួនប្រេងខ្យង
recipe_title: Cha trakuon, stir-fried water spinach with garlic and oyster sauce (ឆាត្រកួនប្រេងខ្យង)
description: Essential Cambodian everyday side dish: crunchy morning glory flash-fried in a searing wok with garlic and fermented soybean.
ingredients: ["1 large bunch water spinach (morning glory/trakuon), washed and cut into 6 cm lengths", "6 cloves garlic, crushed", "2 bird's eye chillies, bruised", "2 tbsp oyster sauce", "1 tbsp fermented yellow soybean paste (optional)", "1 tbsp fish sauce", "½ tsp sugar", "2 tbsp vegetable oil"]
steps: ["Wash morning glory thoroughly, drain well, and place in a large prep bowl.", "Pile crushed garlic, chillies, oyster sauce, soybean paste, fish sauce and sugar directly on top of the greens.", "Heat oil in a wok over the highest flame until smoking hot.", "Dump the greens and seasonings into the wok all at once; toss constantly with a spatula for 60–90 seconds.", "Remove immediately while the leaves are just wilted and stems remain bright green and crunchy; serve hot with rice."]

dish_name: Kuy teav kok (dry Phnom Penh noodles)
dish_name_kh: គុយទាវគោក
recipe_title: Kuy teav kok, Phnom Penh dry noodles with savoury glaze & side broth (គុយទាវគោក)
description: Popular dry variation of Kuy Teav: chewy rice noodles tossed in caramelized garlic-soy sauce, topped with pork and prawns, served with a separate bowl of broth.
ingredients: ["250 g flat rice noodles", "100 g minced pork", "100 g sliced roast pork (char siu)", "6 peeled poached prawns", "2 cups rich pork bone broth with sliced daikon", "1 cup bean sprouts", "2 tbsp crispy fried garlic in oil", "1 bunch Chinese celery and scallions, chopped", "Glaze: 1½ tbsp dark soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp light soy sauce, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp fish sauce"]
steps: ["Brown the minced pork in a skillet with 1 tsp soy sauce and garlic oil; set aside.", "Simmer the dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, light soy sauce, sugar and fish sauce in a small pan for 1 minute to make the glaze.", "Blanch rice noodles and bean sprouts in boiling water for 30 seconds; drain well and divide into bowls.", "Pour warm glaze and crispy garlic oil over noodles; toss vigorously until noodles are glossy and dark.", "Arrange char siu slices, cooked minced pork, and poached prawns over the noodles, garnishing with Chinese celery and scallions.", "Ladle hot bone broth into separate side soup bowls with black pepper and spring onions, and serve together."]

dish_name: Cha mi hoon (stir-fried glass noodles)
dish_name_kh: ឆាមីសួ
recipe_title: Cha mi hoon, stir-fried glass noodles with pork and wood-ear mushrooms (ឆាមីសួ)
description: Light and flavourful stir-fry of mung bean vermicelli noodles, pork, dried mushrooms, cabbage, and scrambled egg.
ingredients: ["200 g mung bean glass noodles (mi hoon), soaked in warm water for 15 minutes and drained", "200 g pork loin, thinly sliced", "4 dried wood-ear mushrooms, soaked and sliced", "1 cup shredded cabbage", "1 carrot, julienned", "2 eggs", "4 cloves garlic, minced", "2 tbsp oyster sauce", "1½ tbsp soy sauce", "1 tsp sugar", "½ tsp ground Kampot pepper", "2 tbsp vegetable oil"]
steps: ["Cut soaked glass noodles with kitchen shears into shorter manageable lengths.", "Scramble eggs in 1 tbsp oil in a wok, remove and set aside.", "Add remaining oil to wok, sauté minced garlic, add sliced pork and stir-fry until cooked through.", "Add wood-ear mushrooms, shredded cabbage and carrots; stir-fry for 2 minutes.", "Add glass noodles, oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar and 3 tbsp water; toss constantly over medium-high heat for 2–3 minutes until noodles absorb all liquid.", "Fold in scrambled eggs, dust with freshly ground Kampot pepper, and serve."]

dish_name: Sngor chruok spey (sour pickled mustard greens soup)
dish_name_kh: ស្ងោរជ្រក់ស្ពៃ
recipe_title: Sngor chruok spey, sour pork ribs soup with pickled mustard greens (ស្ងោរជ្រក់ស្ពៃ)
description: Comforting homestyle soup: pork spare ribs gently simmered with tangy pickled mustard greens and fresh ginger.
ingredients: ["400 g pork spare ribs, cut into small pieces", "250 g pickled mustard greens (spey chruok), rinsed and sliced into 3 cm pieces", "1.2 litres water", "3 cloves garlic, smashed", "1 thumb ginger, sliced", "1½ tbsp fish sauce", "1 tsp sugar", "½ tsp salt", "Ground black pepper and chopped scallions, to serve"]
steps: ["Blanch pork ribs in boiling water for 3 minutes, then drain and rinse clean.", "Bring 1.2 litres fresh water to a boil with smashed garlic and sliced ginger; add pork ribs.", "Simmer on medium-low heat for 25 minutes, skimming any surface impurities.", "Add the sliced pickled mustard greens and simmer for 15 minutes more until ribs are tender and the broth takes on the tangy flavour.", "Season with fish sauce, sugar and salt; taste broth and adjust seasonings.", "Ladle into bowls, sprinkle with fresh scallions and cracked Kampot black pepper, and serve with rice."]

dish_name: Tuk trey Koh Kong (spicy sweet lime seafood sauce)
dish_name_kh: ទឹកត្រីកោះកុង
search: tuk trey koh kong seafood sauce
recipe_title: Tuk trey Koh Kong, coastal sweet, sour and spicy dipping sauce (ទឹកត្រីកោះកុង)
description: Legendary Cambodian dipping sauce from coastal Koh Kong: pounded bird's eye chillies, garlic, palm sugar, lime juice, and fish sauce.
ingredients: ["10 red and green bird's eye chillies", "6 cloves garlic, peeled", "4 tbsp fresh lime juice", "3 tbsp quality fish sauce", "2½ tbsp Cambodian palm sugar", "1 tbsp warm water"]
steps: ["Pound garlic cloves and bird's eye chillies in a stone mortar until a fragrant coarse paste forms.", "Add palm sugar and warm water to the mortar, crushing and grinding with pestle until sugar is fully dissolved.", "Stir in freshly squeezed lime juice and fish sauce.", "Whisk until harmonious; the profile should be vividly sour, spicy, sweet and savoury.", "Serve in dipping bowls alongside grilled prawns, grilled squid, cockles, or fried fish."]

dish_name: Cha preng khtis (seafood stir-fry in coconut kroeung)
dish_name_kh: ឆាគ្រឿងខ្ទិះគ្រឿងសមុទ្រ
recipe_title: Cha preng khtis, mixed seafood stir-fried in rich coconut kroeung (ឆាគ្រឿងខ្ទិះគ្រឿងសមុទ្រ)
description: Lush coastal stir-fry: fresh squid and prawns wok-fried in rich red kroeung, coconut cream, and sweet basil.
ingredients: ["200 g fresh squid, cleaned and scored", "200 g prawns, peeled and deveined", "Kroeung: 2 stalks lemongrass, thinly sliced, 3 cm galangal, sliced, 3 cm fresh turmeric (or 1 tsp ground), 4 kaffir lime leaves, stems removed, 4 cloves garlic, 3 shallots, 5 dried red chillies, soaked", "150 ml thick coconut cream", "1 tbsp fish sauce", "1½ tbsp palm sugar", "1 handful holy basil or sweet basil leaves", "2 red chillies, sliced", "1 tbsp vegetable oil"]
steps: ["Pound the red kroeung into a fine paste.", "Heat oil in a wok and fry the kroeung paste for 2 minutes until fragrant.", "Pour in coconut cream and simmer until coconut oil begins to glisten on the surface.", "Add squid and prawns, tossing over high flame for 3–4 minutes until seafood is just cooked through.", "Season with fish sauce and palm sugar.", "Stir in fresh basil leaves and chilli slices for 30 seconds until wilted, and serve hot with jasmine rice."]

dish_name: Samlor mju prey (wild country sour soup)
dish_name_kh: សម្លម្ជូរព្រៃត្រីឆ្អើរ
recipe_title: Samlor mju prey, wild country sour soup with smoked fish and bamboo (សម្លម្ជូរព្រៃត្រីឆ្អើរ)
description: Rustic country soup made with fragrant smoked river fish, tender bamboo shoots, wild sour leaves, and holy basil.
ingredients: ["200 g smoked river fish (trey chhae), broken into pieces", "1 cup sliced tender bamboo shoots", "1.2 litres water", "2 tbsp yellow kroeung paste", "1 tbsp prahok", "2 tbsp green tamarind pulp or sour leaves (slek trormoang)", "1 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tsp sugar", "1 handful fresh holy basil leaves", "2 bird's eye chillies"]
steps: ["Bring water to a boil in a pot; dissolve prahok and yellow kroeung paste into the liquid.", "Add bamboo shoots and simmer for 10 minutes.", "Add smoked fish pieces and bruised chillies, simmering for 10 minutes to allow the smoky flavour to infuse the broth.", "Stir in tamarind pulp, fish sauce and sugar to create a bold tart profile.", "Turn off heat, stir in fresh holy basil leaves, and serve hot with rice."]

dish_name: Bok trop kchey (pounded pea eggplant with smoked fish)
dish_name_kh: បុកត្រប់ក្ដៀប
recipe_title: Bok trop kchey, pounded wild pea eggplant dip with smoked fish (បុកត្រប់ក្ដៀប)
description: Intensely savoury traditional country relish of charred pea eggplants, flaked smoked fish, garlic, chillies, and prahok.
ingredients: ["1 cup wild pea eggplants (trop kchey)", "100 g flaked smoked river fish", "5 cloves garlic, unpeeled", "4 shallots, unpeeled", "5 bird's eye chillies", "1 tbsp prahok, grilled or boiled in 3 tbsp water", "1 tbsp lime juice", "1 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tsp sugar", "Fresh raw vegetables to serve: cucumber, green beans, cabbage"]
steps: ["In a dry skillet, roast unpeeled garlic, shallots, chillies and pea eggplants until charred and blistered.", "Peel garlic and shallots; pound with roasted chillies in a mortar until crushed.", "Add pea eggplants and pound lightly to bruise without turning into puree.", "Add flaked smoked fish and prahok, pounding gently to combine.", "Season with lime juice, fish sauce and sugar.", "Serve in a shallow bowl with hot rice and raw greens."]

dish_name: Nhoam trey sdath (pomelo and poached chicken salad)
dish_name_kh: ញាំក្រូចថ្លុងសាច់មាន់
recipe_title: Nhoam kroch thlong sach moan, fresh pomelo salad with chicken and mint (ញាំក្រូចថ្លុងសាច់មាន់)
description: Refreshing royal salad of succulent Kratie pomelo sacs tossed with shredded poached chicken, toasted coconut, and sweet lime dressing.
ingredients: ["3 cups fresh pomelo segments, separated into bite-sized sacs", "200 g poached chicken breast, shredded", "3 tbsp toasted grated coconut", "2 shallots, thinly sliced", "1 handful fresh mint leaves", "2 tbsp roasted peanuts, crushed", "1 red chilli, thinly sliced", "Dressing: 2 tbsp fish sauce, 2 tbsp lime juice, 2 tbsp palm sugar, 1 clove garlic minced"]
steps: ["Poach chicken breast until tender, cool, and shred into fine strands.", "Whisk fish sauce, lime juice, palm sugar and minced garlic in a bowl until sugar is dissolved.", "In a large bowl, combine pomelo sacs, shredded chicken, sliced shallots, mint leaves and chilli slices.", "Drizzle dressing gently over salad and toss with light hands to keep pomelo sacs intact.", "Transfer to a platter and sprinkle with toasted coconut and crushed peanuts."]

dish_name: Borbor tnaot (sweet palm fruit tapioca pudding)
dish_name_kh: បបរត្នោត
recipe_title: Borbor tnaot, warm sweet sugar palm fruit pudding with coconut cream (បបរត្នោត)
description: Traditional Cambodian dessert featuring tender translucent palm fruit seeds simmered with tapioca pearls, palm sugar, and coconut milk.
ingredients: ["300 g fresh sugar palm fruit (plae tnaot), peeled and sliced", "½ cup small tapioca pearls", "600 ml water", "120 g Cambodian palm sugar", "250 ml thick coconut milk", "½ tsp salt", "2 pandan leaves, tied in a knot"]
steps: ["Soak tapioca pearls in water for 15 minutes.", "Bring water to a boil in a saucepan with pandan leaves and palm sugar until melted.", "Add soaked tapioca pearls and simmer on medium-low heat for 10 minutes, stirring frequently, until tapioca turns translucent.", "Add sliced sugar palm fruit and simmer for 5 minutes.", "In a separate small pot, warm coconut milk with salt.", "Ladle sweet warm palm fruit tapioca into bowls, spoon salted coconut cream over top, and serve warm."]

dish_name: Cha kdam kroeung (stir-fried crab in red kroeung)
dish_name_kh: ក្តាមឆាគ្រឿង
recipe_title: Cha kdam kroeung, fresh crabs wok-tossed in aromatic red kroeung (ក្តាមឆាគ្រឿង)
description: Fragrant, spicy stir-fried sea crabs in rich lemongrass-turmeric paste, finished with coconut milk and holy basil.
ingredients: ["2 whole blue crabs, cleaned and quartered (claws cracked)", "Kroeung: 2 stalks lemongrass, thinly sliced, 3 cm galangal, sliced, 3 cm fresh turmeric (or 1 tsp ground), 4 kaffir lime leaves, stems removed, 4 cloves garlic, 3 shallots, 5 dried red chillies, soaked", "100 ml coconut milk", "1 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tbsp palm sugar", "1 onion, cut into wedges", "1 handful holy basil leaves", "2 tbsp vegetable oil"]
steps: ["Pound the red kroeung into a fine paste.", "Heat oil in a wok over medium-high heat and fry red kroeung for 2 minutes until fragrant.", "Add crab pieces and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes until shells turn bright orange.", "Pour in coconut milk, fish sauce, palm sugar and onion wedges; toss, cover and steam for 3 minutes until crab is cooked through.", "Fold in holy basil leaves, toss until wilted and fragrant, and serve hot with jasmine rice."]

dish_name: Sngor trey bampe (clear fish soup with tamarind leaves)
dish_name_kh: ស្ងោរជ្រក់ត្រីស្លឹកអម្ពិល
recipe_title: Sngor trey sleuk ampil, clear river fish soup with young tamarind leaves (ស្ងោរជ្រក់ត្រីស្លឹកអម្ពិល)
description: Delicate sour soup made with sweet freshwater fish, fragrant young tamarind leaves, lemongrass, and fresh herbs.
ingredients: ["500 g freshwater fish steaks (catfish or snakehead), cleaned", "1.2 litres water", "1 cup young tender tamarind leaves (sleuk ampil kchey)", "2 stalks lemongrass, bruised", "3 shallots, crushed", "4 cloves garlic", "1 thumb galangal, sliced", "2 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tsp sugar", "½ tsp salt", "Rice paddy herb (ma-om) and bird's eye chillies, to serve"]
steps: ["Bring water to a boil in a pot with lemongrass, galangal, crushed shallots and garlic for 5 minutes.", "Add fish steaks and simmer gently on medium heat for 8–10 minutes until tender, skimming off foam.", "Add young tamarind leaves and simmer for 2 minutes to impart their natural citrusy tang.", "Season with fish sauce, sugar and salt to create a refreshing sour balance.", "Turn off heat, add chopped ma-om and crushed chillies, and serve steaming hot with rice."]
